concepts.title: 解指数方程
concepts.summary: 合法底数 $a>0,a\ne1$ 的指数函数为正且一一对应：$a^u=a^v\Rightarrow u=v$。底数为1时是常函数，不能比较指数。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先隔离指数项；能同底就比较指数，否则取对数。若出现 $a^{2x},a^x$，令 $y=a^x>0$ 转成多项式，舍去非正 $y$。

pitfalls: 不同底数时必须将所有含 $x$ 的项收集到一起。

en.title: Solve exponential equations
en.summary: For a valid base $a>0,a\ne1$, an exponential function is positive and one-to-one: $a^u=a^v\Rightarrow u=v$. Base 1 is constant, so equal outputs do not imply equal exponents.

method.title: Method
method.body: Isolate the exponential term; compare exponents for a common base, otherwise take logs. For $a^{2x},a^x$, set $y=a^x>0$ to obtain a polynomial and reject nonpositive $y$.

pitfalls: With different bases collect every term containing $x$ together.

concepts.title: 指数方程的应用

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用统一时间起点、单位和增长率建立方程。隔离幂后取对数；模型年份等于基准年份加 $t$。

pitfalls: 连续年利率与每年一次复利的年利率不同。

en.title: Applications of exponential equations
en.summary: Discrete growth is $P=P_0(1+r)^t$; continuous growth is $P=P_0e^{rt}$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Use consistent time origin, units, and growth rate. Isolate the power and take logs; the modeled year equals the base year plus $t$.

pitfalls: A continuous annual rate differs from a rate compounded once per year.

concepts.title: 解对数方程与验根
concepts.summary: 对数真数必须为正。$\log_aN=c\iff N=a^c$；同底对数相等则真数相等。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先列定义域，再合并对数、转指数形式或比较真数。解代数方程后逐一检验原式真数，舍去增根。

pitfalls: 合并后的乘积为正不保证原式各个真数为正。

en.title: Solve logarithmic equations and check candidates
en.summary: Every logarithmic argument must be positive. $\log_aN=c\iff N=a^c$; equal logs with the same base have equal arguments.

method.title: Method
method.body: List the domain, then condense logs and convert to exponential form or equate arguments. Solve the algebraic equation and test every original argument to reject extraneous roots.

pitfalls: A positive condensed product does not ensure that each original argument is positive.

concepts.title: 逻辑斯蒂增长模型
concepts.summary: $P(t)=M/(1+ae^{-kt})$，增长模型要求承载量 $M>0$ 且 $a,k>0$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $P(0)=M/(1+a)$ 求 $a$；再由 $e^{-kt}=(M/P(t)-1)/a$ 求 $k$。增长模型的两条水平渐近线为 $P=0$ 与 $P=M$。

pitfalls: 模型要求人口正且低于承载量；不要把代数函数的负值当人口。

en.title: Logistic growth model
en.summary: $P(t)=M/(1+ae^{-kt})$; the growth model requires carrying capacity $M>0$ and $a,k>0$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Find $a$ from $P(0)=M/(1+a)$, then find $k$ from $e^{-kt}=(M/P(t)-1)/a$. The growth model has horizontal asymptotes $P=0$ and $P=M$.

pitfalls: A population must be positive and below carrying capacity; do not interpret a negative algebraic function value as a population.

concepts.title: 指数与对数不等式
concepts.summary: 底数大于1时指数和对数函数递增，底数在0与1之间时递减。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先求定义域并隔离指数/对数项；单调变换时检查不等号方向，尤其除以负的 $\ln a$。最后与定义域取交集。

pitfalls: 对数不等式中的真数限制通常是严格不等式。

en.title: Exponential and logarithmic inequalities
en.summary: Exponential and logarithmic functions increase for bases above1 and decrease for bases between0 and1.

method.title: Method
method.body: Find the domain and isolate the exponential/logarithmic term; check direction under monotone transformations, especially when dividing by negative $\ln a$. Intersect with the domain.

pitfalls: Argument restrictions in a logarithmic inequality are usually strict.

concepts.title: 反函数、参数与论证（习题拓展）
concepts.summary: 交换 $x,y$ 后解 $y$ 求反函数；结合定义域、位数与换底分析参数或恒等式。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 解方程保留全部实根并逐个验定义域；反函数的定义域为原函数值域。位数 $d$ 要满足 $d-1\le\log N<d$。

en.title: Inverse functions, parameters, and reasoning (exercise extension)
en.summary: Swap $x,y$ and solve for $y$ to find an inverse; use domains, digit counts, and change of base for parameters or identities.

method.title: Method
method.body: Retain all real candidates and check each domain; an inverse’s domain is the original range. A $d$-digit number satisfies $d-1\le\log N<d$.

steps.body: Change base and reciprocate: $1/\log_{xy}(xyz)=\ln(xy)/\ln(xyz)$, and likewise for the other terms.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: The sum is $[\ln(xy)+\ln(yz)+\ln(xz)]/\ln(xyz)=2(\ln x+\ln y+\ln z)/(\ln x+\ln y+\ln z)=2$.

en.answer: $2$, under the conditions in the steps.

exercises.prompt: logistic函数 $f(t)=P/(1+ae^{-kt})$ 在 $f(t)=P/2$ 时增长速率最大。求增长速率最大时的时间。

steps.title: 步骤3
steps.body: 如果情境只允许 $t\ge0$，则 $a\ge1$ 时该时刻可用；若 $0<a<1$，拐点在开始以前，在 $t\ge0$ 内的最大增长率已在 $t=0$ 出现。

exercises.answer: $t=\ln a/k$；若只允许非负时间且 $a<1$，则最大值在 $t=0$。

en.prompt: For the logistic function $f(t)=P/(1+ae^{-kt})$, the maximum growth rate occurs when $f(t)=P/2$. Find the time of maximum growth.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: For growth, assume $P>0,a>0,k>0$. Set $P/(1+ae^{-kt})=P/2$ and cancel $P$ to get $1+ae^{-kt}=2$.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: $ae^{-kt}=1$, so $e^{-kt}=1/a$. Take logs: $-kt=-\ln a$, giving $t=\ln a/k$.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: If the context restricts $t\ge0$, this time is available for $a\ge1$. If $0<a<1$, the inflection occurred before the start, and maximum growth on $t\ge0$ occurs at $t=0$.

en.answer: $t=\ln a/k$; if only nonnegative time is allowed and $a<1$, the maximum occurs at $t=0$.

exercises.prompt: 解下列方程，并解释为什么三个方程的解集不全相同：(a)$\log_4[(x-1)^2]=3$；(b)$2\log_4(x-1)=3$；(c)$2\log_4|x-1|=3$。

steps.title: 步骤4
steps.body: 准确规则是 $\log_4(u^2)=2\log_4|u|$（$u\ne0$），不是对所有非零 $u$ 都等于 $2\log_4u$。(a)与(c)确实有相同解集；(b)因真数必须正而排除 $-7$。

en.prompt: Solve and explain why the three equations do not all have identical solution sets: (a)$\log_4[(x-1)^2]=3$; (b)$2\log_4(x-1)=3$; (c)$2\log_4|x-1|=3$.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: The correct rule is $\log_4(u^2)=2\log_4|u|$ for $u\ne0$, not $2\log_4u$ for every nonzero $u$. Parts(a)and(c)do have identical solution sets; part(b)excludes $-7$ because its logarithm argument must be positive.

en.answer: (a)$\{-7,9\}$; (b)$\{9\}$; (c)$\{-7,9\}$. The distinction is the domain in(b); (a)and(c)are equivalent.
